newsitem.title: UK: Cedel announces organisational changes at Liberty.
newsitem.headline: Cedel announces organisational changes at Liberty.

text.p: Cedel Group's global order-routing service subsidiary Liberty, has undergone some organisational changes, Cedel International chief executive officer Andre Lussi said in a statement on Wednesday.
"These changes will allow Liberty to be closer to our customers and financial markets and to better respond to their needs," the statement said.
Antonio Riera was appointed chairman of the board of Liberty. Jeff Metter was appointed vice chairman.
Curt Brill was appointed managing director of Liberty.
The statement said Liberty intended to launch its InterTrade Direct and Direct Route services throughout Asia in 1997.
